name: Being Wealthy
overview: Scripture teaches that true wealth is not found in earthly riches, which are temporary and vulnerable to decay and theft, but in treasures stored in heaven through obedience and generosity, as Jesus instructs in Matthew 6:19 and 19:21. The Bible warns against the dangers of riches, highlighting the spiritual peril awaiting the wealthy who trust in their wealth rather than God, as seen in James 5:1 and the cautionary example of the rich man in Luke 16:19. Believers are reminded to seek contentment with their provision, neither desiring poverty nor riches excessively, and to remember that God is not to be equated with material wealth (Proverbs 30:8; Acts 17:29).
